verdicts.decision_note: The client identifies a material unresolved PCB configuration question about whether VRTC should remain unconnected or receive the datasheet capacitor.
The client specifies implementation-relevant PCB routing for PWROK and VBACKUP as signal-only test pads or vias supporting debugging and future backup power.

The client resolves the PCB configuration by requiring VRTC to remain unconnected and VBACKUP to be exposed only as an initially unpopulated test pad or via; no stale conflicting key requires removal.
The client explicitly resolves the earlier VRTC uncertainty, returning the auxiliary-pin configuration to an actionable state.
This is the first target-specific implementation claim for the VBACKUP and VRTC PCB changes, although the claimed implementation conflicts with the client specification.
The claimed 2.54 mm VBACKUP header and routed VRTC output materially conflict with the client-confirmed test-pad-only VBACKUP interface and unconnected VRTC configuration.
